validation.installation_probe_source:
import hashlib
import importlib.metadata
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import torch
import tide

control=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
installed=Path(tide.__file__).resolve()
assert installed.is_relative_to(control/'clean-env')
source=control/'frozen-current/src/tide'
for p in source.glob('*.py'):
    assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).digest()==hashlib.sha256((installed.parent/p.name).read_bytes()).digest()
result={'python':sys.version,'executable':sys.executable,'torch':torch.__version__,
        'torch_npu_distribution':importlib.metadata.version('torch-npu'),
        'tide':str(installed),'package':importlib.metadata.version('tide-instances'),
        'vendor_autoload_disabled':True,'installed_source_bytes_match':True}
(control/'install-probe.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(result),flush=True)
